eind: Both figures in three-quarter front view, standing upright, feet hip-width apart. She holds TWO separate dumbbells, one in each hand (NOT a barbell), with a neutral grip: palms facing each other. TOP: dumbbells at shoulder height just in front of the shoulders, elbows bent and pointing forward-down. BOTTOM: both arms pressed straight up overhead, dumbbells above the head, palms still facing each other.

Both figures in strict side profile with a simple chair placed directly BEHIND her (the chair must be visible in both figures). TOP: standing upright in front of the chair, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed or reaching forward. BOTTOM: hips pushed back and knees bent so her buttocks hover JUST ABOVE the chair seat without sitting down, back straight, arms reaching forward for balance. NOT a deep squat below seat height.

Both figures in strict side profile on an exercise mat, on hands and knees (four-point kneeling): hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat. TOP: both knees on the mat. BOTTOM: one leg lifted backward and up with the knee kept BENT at about 90 degrees, sole of the foot facing the ceiling, the thigh in line with the back; the other knee stays on the mat. NOT standing, NOT a straight leg.

Both figures lying on the back on an exercise mat, seen from the side, both hands behind the head with elbows out, hands STAY behind the head in both figures. TOP: lying flat, both legs stretched straight on the mat, head and shoulders slightly lifted. BOTTOM: one knee pulled up toward the chest while the upper body twists so the OPPOSITE elbow moves toward that knee; the other leg stays straight just above the mat. NOT a plank, NOT on hands and toes.

Both figures in strict side profile, lying on the back on an exercise mat with both feet on a bosu ball placed with the DOMED (round, inflated) side UP and the flat platform on the floor; knees bent, arms flat beside the body. TOP: hips resting on the mat. BOTTOM: hips pushed up until shoulders, hips and knees form one straight line, feet still on top of the dome. The bosu dome must face up in both figures.

Both figures in strict side profile, with a TRX suspension strap hanging from above behind her. She stands on one leg; the top of the BACK foot rests in the strap's foot loop behind her, about knee height. Both hands are free (on the hips), NOT holding the handles. TOP: standing tall on the front leg. BOTTOM: the front knee bent to about 90 degrees and the body lowered, the back foot still in the loop, trunk upright.

Both figures in strict side profile, STANDING upright on a yoga mat (NOT lying down). TOP: standing tall on both feet, arms relaxed. BOTTOM: standing on one leg, the other knee lifted and pulled toward the chest with both hands clasped around the shin just below the knee, trunk upright, looking forward.

Both figures in strict side profile, SEATED (NOT lying on the stomach) on a seated leg-curl machine, back against a slightly reclined backrest, a padded roller lying across the top of the thighs to hold them down and a second padded roller behind the lower legs just above the heels, hands on the side handles. TOP: legs almost straight forward. BOTTOM: knees bent so the heels are pulled down and back under the seat, the thighs stay under the roller.
